- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (sentiment > 0.5) — reduce forecast peak values by 5–10%.
- Underestimate prices in bearish sentiment (sentiment < 0.3) — increase forecast lows by 5–10%.
- Avoid sharp upward spikes in forecast after recent price drops — cap 30d forecast peaks at 1.2x prior 18d high.
- Apply mean reversion bias: if 18d price range is narrow, forecast should not deviate more than ±1.5σ from recent mean.
- Lag correction: if sentiment is rising, forecast should not be 3+ days ahead of true price trend — align 30d forecast with 18d moving average.
- Overshoot after spikes: if forecast exceeds true price by >15% in 3 consecutive days, reduce next forecast by 10–15% to avoid overcorrection.
